Bush wrote and produced it using a Fairlight CMI synthesiser and a LinnDrum drum machine. The lyrics imagine a man and a woman who make "a deal with God" to exchange places. factoids.title: A title with two lives
factoids.content: The song was originally titled “A Deal With God”; “Running Up That Hill” became its released title, while the subtitle preserves the original phrase.

factoids.title: A song revisited in remixes
factoids.content: MusicBrainz lists a 2012 remix of this recording, along with later remix versions credited to Club Bizarre, Daisy O’Dell, Juelz and others.

factoids.title: A sample in another track
factoids.content: MusicBrainz identifies Kate Bush’s recording as sampled in “Independence” by Contopp nd #Sloppit#.

factoids.title: A song taken up by other artists
factoids.content: MusicBrainz records covers of the song by artists including Within Temptation, Tori Amos and Placebo.

claims.text: Kate Bush's recording was first released on 30 July 1985.
claims.verdictReason: The MusicBrainz recording excerpt gives its first-release date as 1985-07-30.

claims.text: The song was written and produced by Kate Bush, who used a Fairlight CMI synthesiser and a LinnDrum drum machine.
claims.verdictReason: The Wikipedia excerpt states Bush wrote and produced it using both named instruments.

claims.text: The song was originally titled “A Deal With God”; “Running Up That Hill” became its released title, while the subtitle preserves the original phrase.
claims.verdictReason: The BBC excerpt confirms the title change but does not explain the subtitle.

claims.text: MusicBrainz lists a 2012 remix of this recording, along with later remix versions credited to Club Bizarre, Daisy O’Dell, Juelz and others.
claims.verdictReason: The MusicBrainz remix excerpts name four versions but establish no dates for the others.

claims.text: MusicBrainz identifies Kate Bush’s recording as sampled in “Independence” by Contopp nd #Sloppit#.
claims.verdictReason: The MusicBrainz sampled-by excerpt names “Independence” by Contopp nd #Sloppit#.

claims.text: MusicBrainz records covers of the song by artists including Within Temptation, Tori Amos and Placebo.
claims.verdictReason: The three MusicBrainz work excerpts name covers by Within Temptation, Tori Amos and Placebo.
